t: A four-wheel ROS robot kit for learning mapping, navigation, and robot vision.
steps: Choose your host board first. Then order the matching ROSMASTER X3 kit from Yahboom or RobotShop.
Download the Yahboom system image for your host board.
Flash the image to the memory card or drive for the host.
Assemble the chassis, battery, and sensors with the build videos.
Charge the battery and power on the robot.
Install the Yahboom phone app and drive the robot around.
Open the ROS 2 course and run the first keyboard control example.
Try the LiDAR mapping lesson next.
meta: Open Board. From $659. A few stores.
